mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.4 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration, triggering corporate earnings concerns and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances when UNRATE increases by 0.4pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) signals robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 240.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) consistently drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) during monetary easing cycles supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days via reduced discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise (>0.2pp) signal labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises by >0.2pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.05.
